# test

## Overview
Test sources filter (DartTestSourcesFilter.java) for classifying Dart test files in project view.

## Interface
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.test.DartTestSourcesFilter

## Invariants
- Implements com.intellij.openapi.roots.TestSourcesFilter.

## Side Effects
- Determines if virtual file is inside a test directory.
